# Packages left out of the test, and why

Generated by `experiments/dep-census/census.py`. **Tested:** the 341 packages the self-contained `linux-x64` publish of WebAPI, BackgroundJobExecutor, DbMigrator ships, and the tools whose output ships (dotnet-ef); one row each in [census.md](census.md).

**Out, not NuGet packages:** the frontend's npm packages (layer 3, measured separately), and the .NET SDK itself (the toolchain that builds everything; recorded by its `csc.dll` hash, not rebuilt).

| Total left out | 98 |
